name: Shiratama
source: When the protagonist first meets her her name is Shiratama, when she 'evolves' her name is [url=/c114206]Mitarashi Dango[/url].  She is a maid at Chocolate's house.  She also fulfills the duties of a maid for Chocolate when necessary at school.  She is very protective of Chocolate.  Her hobbies are kendo and saving money.  She hates studying and poverty.  Her dream is to be of service to her family.
